points.description: Names the three key principles of the ISO series: consensus, industry-wide applicability, and voluntary nature. Informal wording counts, e.g. 'agreed by all' for consensus, 'applies across the whole industry' for industry-wide applicability, 'not compulsory' for voluntary. Order does not matter.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only one of the three principles is correctly named, or the idea is stated only halfway.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming all three principles, or two of the three, in any wording; two of three is enough at lenient level. Give 1 mark for one correct principle or a half-formed idea that is on track. Give 0 for no principle named, or for answers that are unrelated to ISO standards. Do not penalise extra remarks unless they contradict one of the three principles, and accept any order.
